title: Words That Belong to Their Fields
text:
Every academic discipline develops a specialised lexicon that carries precise meanings. A biologist describes a 'mutation' in a sense very different from the everyday word, while an economist may use 'liquidity' to describe how easily assets can be converted into cash. Such terms allow experts to communicate efficiently, yet they can also exclude outsiders who lack the background to interpret them.

Students therefore need to learn not only definitions but also the conventions of use that govern each field. A term that is unremarkable in a laboratory report may sound strange in a historical essay. Recognising these boundaries helps writers avoid misapplying vocabulary and signals their membership of a particular scholarly community.

questions.text: According to the first paragraph, how does a biologist's use of 'mutation' differ from the everyday word?
options: It carries a meaning very different from the everyday word
It is spelled differently in scientific texts
It is used only in medical dictionaries
It is never used outside the laboratory

questions.text: According to the second paragraph, what must students learn besides definitions?
options: The spelling rules of each language
The conventions of use in each field

questions.text: Why might a specialised lexicon exclude outsiders, according to the passage?
options: Because outsiders lack the background needed to interpret the terms
Because the terms are written in a secret code
Because experts refuse to use common words
Because the terms change completely every year

questions.text: What can be inferred about a term that is common in a laboratory report but used in a historical essay?
options: It will always be understood by every reader
It may need to follow different conventions of use
It is a sign that the essay is poorly written
It should be avoided in all academic writing

vocabulary.definition: developed for a particular field or purpose
generally accepted ways of doing or using something
lines that mark the limits of something

paragraph_translations: Her akademik disiplin, kesin anlamlar taşıyan uzmanlaşmış bir sözlük geliştirir. Bir biyolog 'mutation' sözcüğünü gündelik kullanımdan çok farklı bir anlamda kullanırken, bir iktisatçı 'liquidity' sözcüğünü varlıkların ne kadar kolay nakde çevrilebileceğini anlatmak için kullanabilir. Bu tür terimler uzmanların verimli iletişim kurmasını sağlar, ancak yorumlamak için gerekli altyapıya sahip olmayan dışarıdakileri de dışarıda bırakabilir.

Bu nedenle öğrencilerin yalnızca tanımları değil, her alanı yöneten kullanım kurallarını da öğrenmesi gerekir. Bir laboratuvar raporunda sıradan görünen bir terim, tarih makalesinde garip gelebilir. Bu sınırları fark etmek, yazarların sözcükleri yanlış yerde kullanmasını önler ve onların belirli bir akademik topluluğa ait olduğunu gösterir.
